feeds.title: Navigate Content Blog
feeds.description: A Sailing Adventure Blog. This blog chronicles the good & the bad about living on a sailboat, sailing in challenging conditions, battling seasickness, sailing with dogs, working while sailing, amazing sailing destinations, and the nitty-gritty details of each sailing passage. Authored by Michelle Segrest.

feeds.title: Sea Bags Sailing Team Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date on races, results and the stories behind the team with Sea Bags Sailing Team blog. The Sea Bags Women's Sailing Team is a group of amateur world-class sailors who race internationally.

feeds.title: Saltwater Journal Blog
feeds.description: Saltwater Journal is a sailing blog focussed on providing the ultimate beginners' guide to sailing and living on a boat. I've set up this sailing blog to give you all the information we learned about buying a boat, living aboard, and to share incredible sailing destinations to help you to start your own sailing journey.

feeds.title: Sacred Horizons Blog
feeds.description: A place to share inspiration as well as all my lessons from life on the sea. I finished the single-handed Transpac from sf to hanalei in 2016 and that was just the beginning.

feeds.title: The Joy of Sailing Blog
feeds.description: The Joy of Sailing Club is an all women, members only sailing and friendship building opportunity provided in a safe, convenient, and educational environment. The Club program is designed for new and accomplished sailors to benefit from sailing skills training, pleasure sailing, camaraderie, and a spirit of enjoying the beauty of our universe.

feeds.title: Missy Goes Boating Blog
feeds.description: Missy Goes Boating is a website that shares tips and reviews on boat gear, recipes, and destinations. The website is run by Missy, who loves boating and enjoys sharing her experiences with others. Missy's website is a great resource for boaters of all experience levels. She offers reviews of a variety of boat gear, as well as recipes for delicious snacks and cocktails to enjoy on the water. Missy also shares tips on where to go boating, from remote anchorages to popular tourist destinations.

feeds.title: Lisa Blair Sails the World Blog
feeds.description: Follow along the journey of Lisa around Antarctica, challenges faced and more! Lisa is the first woman to sail solo around Antarctica and completed the journey in 183 days.

feeds.title: Sailing on, single-handed
feeds.description: A blog about untying knots, releasing lines, weighing anchor and getting under way again, after having lost the captain in my life. I've been a professional artist for over five decades now and my works have been exhibited worldwide in galleries and art museums.

feeds.title: Sarah Scott Sailor
feeds.description: I'm a Black (and white) Woman Sailor on a quest to become the first black woman to circumnavigate the globe solo. This blog captures my adventures as a solo woman sailor!
